title: Concept: Set-Cookie Max-Age exceeds the 400-day browser cap
description: Browsers cap persistent cookie lifetimes at 400 days, so a Max-Age beyond that ceiling is silently shortened. The declared lifetime then overstates retention: a session or token outlives the review window it was approved for.
applicability: Responses that set persistent cookies with Max-Age.
risk: A session, refresh token or device-recognition cookie persists for years in the design while browsers keep it for 400 days, and any environment that does honour the long value keeps a credential far beyond its review.
